description: This file defines kernel package configurations for Marvell SATA and SDIO drivers for the Kirkwood target in the OpenWrt build system. It specifies dependencies, configuration options, associated kernel object files, and descriptions.

methods.name: KernelPackage/ata-marvell-sata
methods.description: Defines the kernel package for Marvell SATA support, including title, dependencies, configuration, files, and autoload settings.

methods.name: KernelPackage/ata-marvell-sata/description
methods.description: Provides a description for the SATA support package.

methods.name: KernelPackage/mvsdio
methods.description: Defines the kernel package for Marvell MMC/SD/SDIO host driver, including title, dependencies, config, files, and autoload.

methods.name: KernelPackage/mvsdio/description
methods.description: Provides a description for the SDIO host driver package.
